prompt.text:
Implement a new TypeScript function `buildWorkshopSubmission(input, earliestDate)` that validates and normalizes a workshop proposal.

Export `WorkshopDraft`, `WorkshopSubmission`, `ValidationResult`, and the function. A draft contains `organizer`, `email`, `title`, `format` (`"online"` or `"onsite"`), `venue`, `summary`, and `registrationCloses`. A successful submission contains the same fields after trimming surrounding whitespace.

All string fields must be strings and non-empty after trimming. An email is valid only when its trimmed form contains exactly one `@`, with non-empty text on both sides. Dates use the exact `YYYY-MM-DD` format and must represent real Gregorian dates. `registrationCloses` may equal `earliestDate` but cannot precede it. For online workshops, normalize `venue` to `"Remote"`; for onsite workshops, retain the trimmed non-empty venue.

Return `{ ok: true, value }` on success or `{ ok: false, errors }` on failure. Errors must be unique and ordered by validation order: organizer, email, title, format, venue, summary, registrationCloses, earliestDate. Invalid `earliestDate` must be reported rather than throwing. Do not mutate or alias the input. Produce one complete strict TypeScript source file using no external packages.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
